fact: The CGAP study describes the Banking Commission as the second recourse instance for financial consumers, provided no other recourse is pending, alongside the OQSF-CI observatory with a broad mission to protect financial services consumers and the AUBEF consumer association, which receives complaints from financial consumers.

The OQSF-CI executive secretary says consumers can bring complaints on financial services to the Observatoire through a green line, an email address and a website, and that financial mediation is part of its consumer-protection mission.
system: Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers (OQSF-CI)

fact: The OQSF-CI executive secretary said the observatory hosts a conciliation and mediation mechanism for amicable settlement of disputes, which any consumer of financial services can use free of charge; the text does not say it covers digital financial services in particular.

The finance ministry's Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers (OQSF-CI) handles complaints about financial services including e-money (mobile money) issuers, through a digital complaints-management application; its executive secretary said it logged 156 complaints in 2024.
